about.text: A Swedish baked pudding (kalvdans) made from colostrum, the first milk a cow gives after calving. The colostrum is seasoned with sugar, salt and usually cinnamon or cardamom, then baked in a water bath until it sets. It is eaten warm or cold with jam, or sliced and fried.
